blocks.text:
A village pub on Melton Road, pictured around 1936. Sydney Pegg's name is visible on the sign — a tobacco dealer's board rather than the pub itself, judging by the wording, so there may have been a shop sharing the frontage.

If you know more about The Generous Briton — when it closed, what stands there now, or who ran it over the years — get in touch and we'll add it here.
